label_method: Manual review of the four NVD snapshots against the reference BBW architecture and existing TARA during this iteration; not an independent benchmark.

cases.label_rationale: The TARA references this CVE, but the NVD ranges in this snapshot exclude installed kernel 5.10.70; review the conflict.
NVD range 5.8 (inclusive) to 5.10.102 (exclusive) includes kernel 5.10.70, and the TARA already references the CVE.
NVD range 2.0.0 through 2.0.11 includes Mosquitto 2.0.10, and this CVE is absent from the TARA.
The exact vulnerable CPE identifies lwIP 2.1.2 on COMP-EBCM, and this CVE is absent from the TARA.
